input.command: cd /workspace/inventory && cat TODO.md 2>/dev/null; echo "---GIT---"; git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; git status --short 2>/dev/null

cd /workspace/inventory && for f in src/inventory/*.py tests/*.py pyproject.toml README.md CHANGELOG.md; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done; echo "=== .env ==="; ls -la; cat .env 2>/dev/null | sed 's/=.*/=<redacted>/'
cd /workspace/inventory && find .gnomon var -type f | head -50; echo "=== gitignore ==="; cat .gitignore; echo "=== gitattributes ==="; cat .gitattributes

cd /workspace/inventory/.gnomon && for f in system.md config.toml policy.toml roles.toml profiles/local_first.toml tools.toml skills/writing-tests.md skills/secrets.md skills/endpoints-and-models.md; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; echo; done

cd /workspace/inventory && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "=== the test bites? (break the impl on purpose) ==="; python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "src")
from inventory.stock import Stock
s = Stock(); s.add("widget", 4); s.add("gadget", 3)
print("total_units:", s.total_units(), "| empty:", Stock().total_units())
EOF

cd /workspace/inventory && cp src/inventory/stock.py /tmp/stock.bak && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re, pathlib
p = pathlib.Path("src/inventory/stock.py")
p.write_text(p.read_text().replace("return sum(self._levels.values())", "return max(self._levels.values(), default=0)"))
EOF
echo "--- mutated impl ---"; python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -4
cp /tmp/stock.bak src/inventory/stock.py
echo "--- restored ---"; python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -2; git diff --stat
cd /workspace/inventory && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "=== diff ==="; git diff; echo "=== untracked/modified ==="; git status --short
